end.summary:
- Practised identifying physical changes using no new substance and changes in shape, size, or state; examples included ice, paper, and melting chocolate.
- Practised classifying changes using evidence; Ananya identified curdling milk and burning a sparkler as chemical changes, and later used new-substance evidence rather than reversibility alone.
- Practised distinguishing melting from dissolving; Ananya identified chocolate as melting and sugar in water as dissolving, but still mixed up whether dissolved sugar remains present.
- The dissolved-sugar mass misconception was seen again at the end and needs checking next time.
end.parentNote: Ananya correctly identified several examples and separated melting chocolate from sugar dissolving, but the idea that dissolved sugar is still present and has mass was not yet consistent by the end. At home, dissolve a spoon of sugar in water, taste the solution, and discuss how evaporating the water can show the sugar again.

Haan, tukde kaagaz hi hain; sirf shape badli, naya padarth nahi bana. Aapka paper bird bhi isi idea se judta hai! Cricket poster ko strips mein kaata jaata hai; celebration mein sparkler jalta hai. Dono ko aasani se pehle jaisa nahi bana sakte. Inmein chemical change kaunsa hai, aur reversibility se zyada zaroori saboot kya hai?
Sparkler jala toh usmein light aati hai aur raakh banti hai... toh woh chemical hua na? Waise poster toh bas cut hua, uska paper wahi raha. Sparkler dikhao na, ek baar jalta hua sparkler ka photo!

Haan, sparkler mein roshni aur raakh banna naye padarth ka saboot hai; poster ke tukde ab bhi kaagaz hain. Use chamakti roshni aur chingariyon ke saath sochiye. Reversibility se zyada zaroori saboot kya hai?

Haan toh... sparkler jala toh usmein light aayi, raakh bani, smell bhi aayi thi thodi si... toh woh chemical hua. Naye substances bante hain usmein, paper cut toh bas shape badla. Reversibility se zyada zaroori saboot hai ki... naya padarth banta hai kya.

Bilkul, sparkler mein raakh jaisa naya padarth banta hai; poster ke tukde kaagaz hi rehte hain. Ab cheeni paani mein gholne ka case sochiye: agar glass ko taraazu par tolkar do chammach cheeni gholen, toh wazan badhega, utna hi rahega, ya ghatega?
pata nahi… mujhe nahi aata yeh
Koi baat nahi. Ek chhota step: cheeni daalne se pehle woh glass ke bahar thi; gholne ke baad glass ke andar hai, chahe dikhe na. Taraazu par rakhe glass mein cheeni aane se wazan kis taraf badlega?
pata nahi… mujhe nahi aata yeh
Koi baat nahi, abhi wazan chhodiye. Maan lijiye glass mein ek chammach cheeni daali, aur woh paani mein dikhna band ho gayi. Kya cheeni ab bhi glass ke andar hai?
cheeni dikh nahi rahi par glass ke andar hai na didi, aapne daali toh... toh wazan badh jaayega?

Haan, cheeni glass mein hi hai, isliye paani wale glass se wazan badhega. Ab ek farq sochiye: room-temperature paani mein sugar ghul jaati hai, aur chocolate garam karne par liquid hoti hai. In dono mein dissolving kaunsa hai, melting kaunsa, aur kyun?

sugar wala dissolving hua na, kyunki woh paani mein gayab ho gayi par hai andar hi… chocolate toh melt hui, jaise ice cream pighalti hai. par didi, agar chocolate thandi karein toh wapas solid ho jaayegi, aur sugar paani ko garam karein toh sugar wapas alag aa sakti hai kya? jaise doodh se curd wapas nahi banta, par sugar wapas aa sakti hai shayad?

Haan, aapne sahi farq bataya: sugar paani mein ghuli hai, chocolate garam hokar pighli hai. Sugar-paani ko garam karke paani uda dein, toh sugar phir mil sakti hai; chocolate thandi hokar jam sakti hai, lekin curd se waise doodh wapas nahi banta. Sugar ab bhi glass mein hai—toh agar glass ko tolte rahein, ghulne ke baad uska wazan ghatega, badhega, ya wahi rahega?
wazan wahi rahega, kyunki sugar hai toh andar hi... par ab dikh nahi rahi toh shayad gayab ho gayi? jaise doodh se curd ban jaata hai phir wapas doodh bana sakte hain na? fridge mein rakh ke?

Aapka pehla point sahi hai: cheeni ghulne se gayab nahi hoti. Lekin doodh se bana dahi fridge mein rakhne par thanda hota hai, wapas doodh nahi banta; dahi ke gun badal chuke hain. Ab chocolate wale case se alag karke sochiye: paani mein cheeni ghulti hai ya pighalti hai, aur garam chocolate ke saath kya hota hai?
didi sugar wala dissolving kiya... par mujhe lag raha hai jaise woh gayab ho gayi, toh pata nahi ab woh maujood hai ya nahi... jaise curd wapas doodh nahi banta waise sugar bhi shayad change ho gayi?

Aap keh rahe hain cheeni dikhti nahi, toh shayad dahi ki tarah badal gayi. Lekin cheeni-paani meetha hota hai; dahi mein doodh se alag khatta swaad aur texture banta hai. Cheeni ko paani se alag bhi kar sakte hain, isliye na dikhna gayab hona nahi hai. Kunal namak ko paani mein milaakar kehta hai ki woh pighal gaya; uske liye kaunsa shabd sahi hoga, aur pighalne se kya farq hai?
